name: grunt
description: Grunt charts and tables: skills for charts and tables inside PowerPoint (grunt-powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (grunt-pptx), in interactive HTML reports (grunt-html) and in Claude Slides decks (grunt-slides). Works through the Grunt connector your organization has connected.

interface.shortDescription: Grunt charts in HTML reports and PowerPoint decks
interface.longDescription: Create Grunt charts and tables through the Grunt connector your organization has connected, then place them on slides inside PowerPoint (grunt-powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (grunt-pptx), in interactive, self-contained HTML reports (grunt-html) or in Claude Slides decks (grunt-slides). Sign in with your own Grunt account.
defaultPrompt: Create a Grunt bar chart of quarterly revenue by region and put it on slide 2 of deck.pptx.
Build an HTML report with a Grunt line chart of monthly customers and a KPI table.
